notes.title: 🛸 Alien Market Simulator - v0.05 Update! 🛍️
notes.content: [h2]👽 [b]🧠 Restocker Staff Arrives![/b][/h2][p] Meet your new best friend: the [b]Restocker[/b]! This helpful employee automatically picks up boxes and refills your shelves with products. No more running around micro-managing stock — just hire one and let them do the heavy lifting (literally).\[/p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218939/d4adc5b37ccd190b78d09805b6e963ffafb3471d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p] 📊 [b]🗓️ Daily Report Tab[/b]Ever wondered how much profit you made, what sold best, or how much you spent on staff? Now you can! Less waiting, more selling![/p][p] 🧾 [b]📋 Market Management UI Upgrade[/b]The [b]Market Management[/b] screen has all your reports, and Parking Update as well. notes.title: 🎉 Alien Market Simulator – NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
🚀 Alien Market Simulator is officially out now!

You can finally dive into the weird, wild world of running your very own shop on an alien planet. Serve bizarre customers, customize your stall, dodge shoplifters, and try to keep your sanity in a galaxy that doesn’t play by Earth rules!

🛒 Build your business
🧪 Sell strange goods
👽 Deal with demanding aliens
😋 Make strange foods for aliens
😱 Survive the unexpected
🫣 And so much more on the way!

Whether you’re in it for the laughs, the chaos, or the thrill of interplanetary capitalism, Alien Market Simulator is ready for you.

[h3]Don’t forget to leave a review or share your funniest in-game moments with us – we’re watching (from a safe distance... probably)![/h3]


[h2]💡 What’s Next for Alien Market Simulator?[/h2]
We’re just getting started! Here’s a sneak peek at what’s coming in future updates:

[h3]👩‍🚀 Lady Staff for Micro-Management[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218939/5c2984acd9261855a1da8b915dda91fa8b52716a.png[/img]
Tired of doing everything yourself? We’ll soon introduce a new lady staff member who can help with critical tasks like restocking shelves and eliminating biomass threats, so you can focus on growing your shop.

[h3]🍜 Food Stall Staff[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218939/5746124ff13463e8efe9dd31e041a19423fb335c.png[/img]
Your alien diners are hungry! A dedicated food stall worker is in the works to take and serve orders, giving your space kitchen a more lively and hands-free operation.

[h3]🌱 Agriculture System (Coming after that)[/h3]
A full farming gameplay loop is planned! You’ll be able to:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218939/7a52202f69c2248e22734659953b02648edc41e1.png[/img]
[b]Seed crops:[/b]
Grow and water plants
Harvest and sell your fresh goods
This will add a whole new layer of depth and strategy to your alien business.

notes.title: Major Demo Update
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to announce a major update for the Alien Market Sim Demo, packed with new features, optimizations, and fixes to make your extraterrestrial market management even smoother. Here’s what’s new:

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[h3]Demo time increased: [/h3]
We have increased the demo playtime to Level 3. And even after that you are free to play as long as you want.

[h3]Cleaner Staff: [/h3]
Keep your market spotless with the new Cleaner Staff! They’ll ensure your station is clean. But they have limited range, dont worry you can upgrade that.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218939/80f97b52330f68ea443cdab3d5a0e43da4ceb0e2.gif[/img]

[h3]Fueling Staff:[/h3]
Power up your market’s operations with dedicated Fueling Staff. Just assign them a fueling station by taking them near one of the station and setting the task!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218939/ff4c022e14f6d3104c0f6b89a5bfc36a05e5f7e2.gif[/img]

[h3]Staff Upgrades: [/h3]
Each staff has some unique properties, you can upgrade them over time. Make them fast and efficient.

[h3]Staff Management Tab: [/h3]
Take full control of your workforce with the new Staff Management Tab. Manage your team with ease.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218939/283b8e00090bcf6f71cfaa03fdad01a66dd1d94e.gif[/img]

[h3]Staff Wanders Around:[/h3]
Got a staff member with some free time? Now you can let them wander around the station, adding a little life and personality to your alien market!

[h3]Set Price Easily:[/h3]
With a single click on the price text, you can change prices of the items now!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218939/832bb4bff6947403fbbea024c3cd7daad9c1d1f9.gif[/img]

[h3]Control Unit Area:[/h3]
A new dedicated area for managing your market’s core systems. Also the garbage disposal machine is here now, with a new and improved lever system for disposal.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218939/69d28c14ce9adc30271ff3cd81114545005fdbed.gif[/img]

[h2]Improvements & Fixes[/h2]
[h3]Save System Errors Fixed:[/h3]
No more lost progress! We’ve resolved issues with the save system to ensure your market data is safe and sound.

[h3]Optimization:[/h3]
Enjoy a smoother experience with performance improvements across the board.

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
Squashed pesky bugs that were causing trouble. Your market will now run more reliably than ever.

We’re constantly working to make Alien Market Sim the best it can be, and your feedback is invaluable. Try out the new features and let us know what you think!

Stay tuned for more updates, and happy market managing!

[h3]- The Alien Market Sim Team
[/h3]
P.S. Don’t forget to [b]Wishlist[/b] the full game if you haven’t already! 🚀

notes.title: 🚀 Alien Market Simulator Demo – Available Now! 👽
notes.content:
Market Simulator?

You’ve been bailed out by the Intergalactic Police, but freedom comes at a price. Now, you must transform a run-down station on a distant planet into a thriving hub for alien travelers, providing snacks, fuel, and services while navigating shady deals and challenging decisions.

[h2]Features to Explore in the Demo:[/h2]

🛸 Space Station Management: Restore, customize, and expand your station to meet the needs of alien visitors.
🛒 Shop Operations: Stock shelves, scan items, and manage your inventory to keep customers happy.
🤖 Robotic Helpers: Hire robots to clean, restock, and assist with customer service.
🚨 Thief Prevention: Watch out for thieves and protect your profits.
👾 Alien Customer Dynamics: Win over quirky alien travelers while managing their demands and complaints.

[h2]What to expect in full release:[/h2]

🌌 Shady Deals: Dive into the thrill of legal and illegal trade—but watch out, or you might get caught!
🛍️ More Items & Shop Features: Expand your shop with exciting new upgrades and items to attract alien customers!
🍴 Food Stalls: Whip up unique dishes for alien patrons. Set up food stalls, serve creative cuisines, and delight your visitors.
🌱 Greenhouse & Agriculture: Grow exotic alien plants in pots, harvest them, and turn your green thumb into green profits!
🛸 Exciting Alien Events: Experience surprising and quirky events that will keep you on your toes.
🌠 Planetary Anomalies: It's a foreign planet—expect the unexpected with strange, fascinating phenomena!
👀 Watch Tower: Oversee your station from your very own watch tower! Customize it, keep an eye on activities, and rule your station like a pro.
✨ ...And So Much More! Get ready for endless fun and surprises in your intergalactic adventure!

notes.title: DEVLOG #1: Added new Alien species and Gooey stuff
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Welcome to the first issue of the Alien Market Simulator [b]devlog![/b]

[h1][b]Q. So what is this devlog thing all about?[/b][/h1]

The community is requesting more information about updates and the progress of the game and this and the future devlogs will hopefully help to keep you updated on what we are working on.

[h1][b]Q. So what's new?[/b][/h1]

We have started adding new characters to the game. Alien Market Simulator features a variety of alien characters, each with a different ability.

[h2][b]New Alien Specie![/b][/h2]
We're Introducing [b]Blorgline the eternal creator![/b] Blorgline's are one of the oldest civilizations of Kepler-Blue and are often known for their role in building the first-ever Space Craft that led Alien life to the outer worlds. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218939/0244bda627f949d8895208f050e111179dcad51b.gif[/img]

While Blorglines are one of the popular creatures for their mastery of Space Tech, They are also recognized for their Blorgline fluid, A disgusting and smelly substance which they fling indiscriminately. In this devlog, we will give an insight into how we brought Blorgline to life and created a Goo shader that uses vertex displacement to create a satisfying Goo effect.

[h3][b]Physics Simulation On Its Wobbly Head[/b][/h3]
To make the character feel a part of the world, We are using Physics-based bone movement to simulate life-like movement in some parts of the body.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218939/482dc7b9ea52f13b5937894776657036ba8c49e7.gif[/img]


[h1][b]The Blorgline Fluid[/b][/h1]
Goo will appear all over the station... so where is it coming from? Well some alien species are nasty. They throw nasty stuff here and there. So you need to clean it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218939/6fdbdc9e6f5c1b7dfc79f3bd1790afa2a88c3067.gif[/img]
So pick it up and keep the station clean
